inputs.text: Phoenix leaders are calling it oversight, but the Wednesday-night vote looks like a move to control where federal immigration enforcement can operate—and to shape what the public gets to see. The new restrictions on ICE and other law enforcement using city property are being sold as accountability, but city officials are still the ones deciding the rules and managing the narrative. The public explanation shouldn’t be taken at face value.
